import openpyxl, os, re
out = os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
ws = wb['Sheet1']
changed = []
for r in range(1, ws.max_row+1):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2)
    v = c.value
    if isinstance(v, str):
        # remove all alphabetic characters and spaces, keep digits
        new = re.sub(r'[^0-9]', '', v)
        if new != v:
            c.value = new
            changed.append((r, v, new))
wb.save(out)
print(changed)
